    colors=sorted(set(x for r in g for x in r)-{0})
    # columns: 3 if any cell in col3, else 9
    colmap={c: 3 if any(g[i][3]==c for i in range(H)) else 9 for c in colors}
    info=[]
    for c in colors:

        barrows=sorted(set(i for i,j in cells if any(g[i][k]==c for k in range(W))))

        # simpler: min row and max colspan
        rows=[i for i,_ in cells]; cols=[j for _,j in cells]
        info.append(dict(color=c, rows=rows, cols=cols, n=len(cells)))
    # order colors by min row
    info.sort(key=lambda x:x['rows'][0])
    def U(cells,col):
        cs=[j for i,j in cells if j==col]
        return max(cs+[x['rows'][-1] if not cs else cs[0]]) if cs else max(x['rows'][-1] for x in info if x['color']==None) if False else None
    # assign bands per column
    colgroups={}

        col=colmap[x['color']]
        if col not in colgroups: colgroups[col]=[]
        colgroups[col].append((i,x))
    res=g

    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in g for x in r)-{0})
    colmap={c: 3 if any(g[i][3]==c for i in range(H)) else 9 for c in colors}

    for c in colors:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        # identify bar rows: rows where color appears >=2 times
        barrows=sorted({i for i,_ in cells if sum(1 for k in range(W) if g[i][k]==c)>1})
        if not barrows: continue
        segcols=sorted({j for i,j in cells if i not in barrows})
        if len(segcols)!=1: continue
        col=segcols[0]
        bot=max(i for i in barrows) if all(j==col for i,j in [(i,k) for i in barrows for k in [j]]) else None
        top=min(barrows)
        L = min(top, max(bot,0)) if False else min(top,bot)
        # fill from bar up and down to edge
        segs.append(dict(color=c,col=col,top=top,bottom=bot,nrows=top-bot+1))
    for s in segs:
        for r in range(s['bottom'],-1,-1):
            if r>s['top'] or r<s['bottom']: pass
        for r in range(s['bottom']+1,s['top']):

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

            e=c-1
            runs.append((r,s,e,v,c-s))
            c=e+1

    # simpler: for each stripe column, walk rows top->bottom painting bands

    # sort marker columns by first appearance

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    H=[row[:] for row in g]
    def runs(r):
        res=[]; c=0
        while c<w:
            v=g[r][c]; s=c
            while c<w and g[r][c]==v: c+=1
            res.append((s,c-1,v)); c=s+1
        return res
    # 1. horizontal gap-fill between consecutive same-color runs
    for r in range(h):
        rs=runs(r)
        for i in range(len(rs)-1):
            if rs[i][2]==rs[i+1][2] and rs[i][1]<rs[i+1][0]:
                for cc in range(rs[i][1]+1, rs[i+1][0]): H[r][cc]=rs[i][2]
    # 2. markers = single-cell runs fully isolated (all 4-neighbors zero)
    markers=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for s,e,v in runs(r):
            if e-s==1 and v!=0:
                L=(s==0 or g[r][s-1]==0); R=(e==w-1 or g[r][e+1]==0)
                U=(r==0 or g[r-1][s]==0); D=(r==h-1 or g[r+1][s]==0)
                if L and R and U and D: markers.append((r,s,v))
    print('markers:',markers)
    # stripe cols: columns with >=2 features
    from collections import defaultdict
    cnt=defaultdict(int)
    for r,s,v in markers: cnt[s]+=1

def runs(r,g):
    res=[]; c=0
    while c<len(g[0]):
        v=g[r][c]; s=c
        while c<len(g[0]) and g[r][c]==v: c+=1
        res.append((s,c-1,v)); c=s+1
    return res

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); H=[row[:] for row in g]
    # 1. horizontal gap-fill
    for r in range(h):
        rs=runs(r,g)
        for i in range(len(rs)-1):
            if rs[i][2]==rs[i+1][2] and rs[i][1]<rs[i+1][0]:
                for cc in range(rs[i][1]+1, rs[i+1][0]): H[r][cc]=rs[i][2]
    # 2. isolated markers -> stripe columns (need >=2 markers in a column)
    marks=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v!=0:
                left = c==0 or g[r][c-1]!=v
                right = c==w-1 or g[r][c+1]!=v
                up = r==0 or g[r-1][c]!=v
                down = r==h-1 or g[r+1][c]!=v
                if left and right and up and down: marks.append((r,c,v))
    from collections import defaultdict
    cnt=defaultdict(int)
    for _,c,_ in marks: cnt[c]+=1
    stripes=sorted(c for n in cnt.values() if n>=2 for c in [c2 for c2,n2 in cnt.items() if n2>=2])
    print('marks:',marks,'stripes:',stripes)
    for col in stripes:

import json
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in {x for r in g for x in r}:
        if c in (0,6,8): continue
        rows=[i for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c]
        r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows)
        cols=[j for j in range(w) for i in rows if g[i][j]==c]
        lo,hi=min(cols),max(cols)
        for i in range(r0,min(r1+2,h)):
            for j in range(lo,hi+1): o[i][j]=c
    return o
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
